cases.description: delta is declared as '*', a wildcard — this is categorically worse than a bounded range because literally any version ever published, including one published tomorrow, resolves. Flagged at high severity (not low, like a plain range), which alone is enough to force suggested_risk_level to REQUIRES_REVIEW.
cases.grounding: delta's pin_status is 'wildcard' (contains '*'); scanner.py sets severity='high' specifically for the wildcard case, distinct from range/missing which are 'low'.
